propositions: The close precheck unconditionally invokes the completion verifier via verify_with_auto_resume even when the ticket already carries a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS attestation bound to the exact resolved close ref.

A stored completion op-cert with authenticated SHA pin, material fingerprint, PASS status, and valid signature should be reused at close time without invoking the provider, reducing redundant verification calls.
Ineligible attestations—those that are malformed, unverifiable, stale, differently pinned, invalidated by reopen, or non-PASS—must fall through to fresh provider verification.
The reuse check must validate that the authenticated verified-at-sha equals the resolved close target SHA and the authenticated material fingerprint matches the ticket's current material fingerprint.
A same-ref reused PASS must produce a signed closed ticket and durable completion evidence via the existing locked close and post-close signing path.
